# compiler: dxc_1_6_2112
# args:     -T lib_6_3 -spirv -fspv-target-env=universal1.5
# exit:     0

; SPIR-V
; Version: 1.5
; Generator: Google spiregg; 0
; Bound: 12
; Schema: 0
               OpCapability Shader
               OpCapability Linkage
               OpMemoryModel Logical GLSL450
          %1 = OpString "/app/example.hlsl"
               OpSource HLSL 630 %1 "//==========================================================================//
// What to look for â #2633, \"can HLSL be compiled to a linkable SPIR-V library?\"
//
// Compiler Explorer is single-file, so both halves of the question are in this one
// source and -DIMPORT_HALF=1 picks which one is compiled. Every pane below differs
// only in the compiler and that define.
//
// Panes 1-2, dxc 1.6.2112 and dxc trunk, no define â the EXPORT half.
//   Compiles. Look for the Linkage capability, and lower down the decoration
//   marking foo as an Export symbol. That is a relocatable library module, and it
//   has worked since v1.6.2104 (2021-04). It needs -fspv-target-env=universal1.5:
//   Vulkan target envs reject the Linkage capability, so such a module has to be
//   linked before a driver will accept it.
//
// Pane 3, dxc trunk, -DIMPORT_HALF=1 â the IMPORT half.
//   Does not compile: \"found undefined function\". foo is declared and never
//   defined, and dxc rejects that instead of emitting an Import symbol for a
//   linker to resolve. This is the half that is missing, and the source is
//   @s-perron's own example from the issue thread.
//
// Panes 4-5, clang trunk, the same two halves.
//   Both compile. Clang's HLSL SPIR-V backend emits an Export decoration for the
//   definition and an Import decoration for the undefined declaration â the shape
//   proposed in this thread in 2024. Two differences worth noticing: clang needs
//   no universal1.5 to do it, and it uses Itanium-mangled symbol names where dxc
//   uses the plain source name, so modules from the two compilers would not
//   currently resolve each other's symbols.
//
// Skip the leading \"-Qembed_debug unused argument\" warning on the clang panes; the
// part that matters is below it.
//==========================================================================//

// #2633 -- both halves of \"link libraries\" in one file, because Compiler
// Explorer is single-file. `-DIMPORT_HALF=1` selects the half.
//
// This is a TRANSFORMATION of the two-file repro (lib-export.hlsl and
// repro.hlsl), so it is checked against them locally before being published:
// variant-ce-export-half-* and variant-ce-import-half-* must reproduce exactly
// what the separate files do.

#ifndef IMPORT_HALF

// ---- EXPORT half: the library that provides `foo`. ------------------------
// Compiles. Emits OpCapability Linkage + LinkageAttributes \"foo\" Export.

export float4 foo(float4 p) { return p * 0.5f; }

#else

// ---- IMPORT half: the module that wants to CALL `foo` from elsewhere. -----
// @s-perron's own case, from https://godbolt.org/z/4s8xaEdTK.
// Does not compile: there is no way to say \"resolve this at link time\".

struct vertexInfo {
  float4 position : POSITION;
};

struct v2p {
  float4 position : SV_POSITION;
};

float4 foo(float4 p);

[shader(\"vertex\")] v2p vertexShader(vertexInfo input) {
  v2p output;
  output.position = foo(input.position);
  return output;
}

#endif
"
               OpName %foo "foo"
               OpName %p "p"
               OpName %bb_entry "bb.entry"
               OpDecorate %foo LinkageAttributes "foo" Export
      %float = OpTypeFloat 32
  %float_0_5 = OpConstant %float 0.5
    %v4float = OpTypeVector %float 4
%_ptr_Function_v4float = OpTypePointer Function %v4float
          %9 = OpTypeFunction %v4float %_ptr_Function_v4float
               OpLine %1 46 1
        %foo = OpFunction %v4float None %9
               OpLine %1 46 26
          %p = OpFunctionParameter %_ptr_Function_v4float
               OpNoLine
   %bb_entry = OpLabel
               OpLine %1 46 38
         %10 = OpLoad %v4float %p
               OpLine %1 46 40
         %11 = OpVectorTimesScalar %v4float %10 %float_0_5
               OpLine %1 46 31
               OpReturnValue %11
               OpFunctionEnd
